title: Hi, we're The Girls Club
paragraphs: We started The Girls Club because every girl deserves to feel glam, without spending hours in a salon chair or a fortune on lashes.
Our cluster lashes are made to be easy. Apply them yourself at home in minutes and walk out feeling like the main character.
Everything here is made and taught by a certified esthetician with a Bachelor's in Education, so whether it's your lashes or a lesson in The Girls Club Academy, you're in trained hands.
This is just the beginning. More DIY beauty is on the way, made for Bajan girls who love a good glow up.
